name: System Status 2 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a system.

SUSP.name: Suspended
SUSP.definition: System is suspended, that is, not operational.

ACTV.name: Active
ACTV.definition: System is functioning normally, that is, operational.

CLSD.name: Closed
CLSD.definition: System is closed (eg. normal closure of an RTGS).

CLSG.name: Closing
CLSG.definition: System needs to wait for completion of intermediate internal activities before going to a status Closed.
